prompt:
Our strategy team at MediCore Health Technologies needs a formal capability assessment report comparing us against Apex Health Systems, our best-in-class competitor. We ran an internal leadership survey and gathered some competitor intelligence — the raw data is scattered across files in the `raw_data/` directory.

Please produce a complete, structured capability assessment document saved as `medicore_capability_assessment.md`. It should cover all six capability dimensions we collected data on: Regulatory Compliance, Clinical AI/ML, Data Infrastructure, Patient Experience Design, Interoperability, and Talent Pipeline.

The report must be actionable — leadership needs to see where we stand, how big our gaps are, and what we should invest in first.
